summary: XCF Global, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a forbearance agreement between its subsidiary New Rise Renewables Reno, LLC and Twain GL XXVIII, LLC. Under the agreement, Twain forbears from exercising rights under a ground lease through January 1, 2027, in exchange for 4,000,000 unregistered shares of XCF common stock. Proceeds from any resale are credited dollar-for-dollar against amounts owed. No price per share, premium, or other deal terms are stated. This is a creditor forbearance coupled with equity issuance, not a merger, tender, or restructuring; it is classified as an 'Other' special situation.
